registers.name: dsig_version
registers.description: Digital signature version register. Reports the IP major and minor version numbers.

fields.name: major
fields.description:
Major version number of the IP. Software reads it to select compatible driver behavior.

Usage: Read after reset and before any other register.

Values:
0x1 major version 1 (reset value).

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: minor
fields.description:
Minor version number of the IP. Software reads it to identify compatible additions.

Usage: Read after reset and before any other register.

Values:
0x0 minor version 0 (reset value).

Unit: none

Limits: none

registers.description: Digital signature SLH-DSA set capability register. Reports which SLH-DSA parameter sets are built.

fields.name: sets
fields.description:
SLH-DSA built set mask. Bit n is 1 when SLH-DSA parameter set number n of the table in section 10 is built.

Usage: Read before programming the SLH-DSA set field of the set register.

Values:

Unit: none

Limits: Constant after reset; 0 when SLH-DSA is not built.

registers.name: dsig_lock
registers.description: Digital signature lock register. Freezes the algorithm enable bits until the next reset.

fields.name: req
fields.description:
Lock request. Command that freezes the algorithm enable bits at their current effective value until the next reset of the core.

Usage: Write 1 once, after the algorithm enable register is final; hardware latches the lock and clears this bit; it reads as 0.

Values:
0x0 no request (reset value);
0x1 request the lock.

Unit: none

Limits: Has no effect when the lock feature is not built; a write of 0 never removes the lock.

fields.name: locked
fields.description:
Lock state. Reports whether the algorithm enable bits are frozen.

Usage: Read after writing the lock request to confirm the lock.

Values:
0x0 not locked (reset value);
0x1 locked.

Unit: none

Limits: Cleared only by a reset of the core.

registers.name: dsig_op
registers.description: Digital signature operation register. Selects the algorithm, the operation and the modes of the next start command.

fields.name: alg
op
form
fields.description:
Message form. Selects whether the message is in the buffer (pure) or only its digest is supplied (prehash).

Usage: Program before the start command; the form must be built.

Values:
0x0 pure message (reset value);
0x1 prehash digest;
0x2 and 0x3 reserved.

Unit: code

Limits: The reserved codes set the unsupported-operation error.

fields.name: hedged
fields.description:
Hedged signing. Selects the hedged form of ML-DSA signing, which adds random bytes, instead of the deterministic form.

Usage: Program before a signing start command of ML-DSA; ignored for other algorithms.

Values:
0x0 deterministic (reset value);
0x1 hedged.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: nonce
fields.description:
ECDSA nonce mode. Selects the source of the ECDSA per-message secret number when the build allows both.

Usage: Program before a signing start command of ECDSA; effective only when the nonce parameter of the build is 2.

Values:
0x0 random from the random source (reset value);
0x1 deterministic as in RFC 6979;
0x2 and 0x3 reserved.

Unit: code

Limits: Ignored when the build fixes the nonce mode; the reserved codes set the unsupported-operation error.

fields.name: slh
fields.description:

Usage: Program before a start command of SLH-DSA; the matching bit of the SLH-DSA capability register must be 1.

Unit: code

fields.name: hsslvl

registers.description: Digital signature message length register. Gives the message length in bytes.

fields.name: len
fields.description:

Usage: Program before the start command, after the data are written.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFFFFFFFF length (reset value 0x0).

Unit: byte

Limits: The length must fit the buffer at the message offset; a longer value sets the buffer-overflow error.

registers.description: Digital signature context length register. Gives the context length in bytes.

fields.name: len
fields.description:

Usage: Program before the start command of an algorithm that uses a context; ignored by the other algorithms.

Values:
0x00 to 0xFF length (reset value 0x00).

Unit: byte

Limits: A length above the limit of the algorithm sets the bad-length error.

registers.name: dsig_cmd
registers.description: Digital signature command register. Starts, aborts and clears.

fields.name: start
fields.description:
Start command. Starts the operation described by the operation, set, length and offset registers.

Usage: Write 1 after the IP is enabled and the data are in the buffer; hardware clears the bit when it accepts the command; it reads as 0.

Values:
0x0 no command (reset value);
0x1 start.

Unit: none

Limits: A start while busy, while the IP is disabled or for a disabled algorithm is rejected and sets an error.

fields.name: abort
fields.description:
Abort command. Stops the running operation without a result and clears the secret state.

Usage: Write 1 to cancel; hardware clears the bit when it takes the command.

Values:
0x0 no command (reset value);
0x1 abort.

Unit: none

Limits: Has no effect when the IP is idle.

fields.name: clr
fields.description:
Clear command. Clears the done, result and error flags and the secret state.

Usage: Write 1 after reading the result; hardware clears the bit when it takes the command.

Values:
0x0 no command (reset value);
0x1 clear.

Unit: none

Limits: Does not clear the enable bits or the lock.

registers.name: dsig_sts
registers.description: Digital signature status register. Reports the state of the current or last operation.

fields.name: busy
fields.description:
Busy. Reports that an operation is running.

Usage: Poll until 0 after a start command, or use the done interrupt.

Values:
0x0 idle (reset value);
0x1 busy.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.description:
Result valid. Reports that an operation completed and its result is in the buffer or in the verify flags.

Usage: Read after done; cleared by the clear command and by a new start.

Values:
0x0 no result (reset value);
0x1 result valid.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: sigok
fields.description:
Signature valid. Reports the outcome of a verification: 1 when the signature is valid under the selected policy.

Usage: Read after done for a verification; meaningless for other operations.

Values:
0x0 invalid or not a verification (reset value);
0x1 valid.

Unit: none

Limits: An invalid signature is not an error flag.

fields.name: edok
fields.description:
Ed25519 part valid. In a hybrid verification, reports that the Ed25519 signature is valid.

Usage: Read after done of a hybrid verification.

Values:
0x0 invalid or not hybrid (reset value);
0x1 valid.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: mlok
fields.description:
ML-DSA part valid. In a hybrid verification, reports that the ML-DSA signature is valid.

Usage: Read after done of a hybrid verification.

Values:
0x0 invalid or not hybrid (reset value);
0x1 valid.

Unit: none

Limits: none

registers.name: dsig_err
registers.description: Digital signature error register. Holds the sticky error flags.

fields.name: algdis
fields.description:
Algorithm disabled error. Sticky flag that the hardware sets when a start command named an algorithm whose enable bit is 0 or that is not built.

Usage: Read after done or after an interrupt; write 1 to this bit to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not set (reset value);
0x1 set.

Unit: none

Limits: A write of 0 keeps the bit; a hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

fields.name: opuns
fields.description:
Operation unsupported error. Sticky flag that the hardware sets when a start command named an operation, mode or parameter set that is not built or is reserved.

Usage: Read after done or after an interrupt; write 1 to this bit to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not set (reset value);
0x1 set.

Unit: none

Limits: A write of 0 keeps the bit; a hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

fields.name: badlen
fields.description:
Bad length error. Sticky flag that the hardware sets when a length or hash pairing is not allowed.

Usage: Read after done or after an interrupt; write 1 to this bit to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not set (reset value);
0x1 set.

Unit: none

Limits: A write of 0 keeps the bit; a hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

fields.name: badkey
fields.description:
Bad key error. Sticky flag that the hardware sets when the private key is malformed or missing.

Usage: Read after done or after an interrupt; write 1 to this bit to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not set (reset value);
0x1 set.

Unit: none

Limits: A write of 0 keeps the bit; a hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

fields.name: badpt
fields.description:
Invalid point or format error. Sticky flag that the hardware sets when a public key, signature or point failed the format or on-curve check.

Usage: Read after done or after an interrupt; write 1 to this bit to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not set (reset value);
0x1 set.

Unit: none

Limits: A write of 0 keeps the bit; a hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

fields.name: bufovf
fields.description:
Buffer overflow error. Sticky flag that the hardware sets when a region does not fit the buffer.

Usage: Read after done or after an interrupt; write 1 to this bit to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not set (reset value);
0x1 set.

Unit: none

Limits: A write of 0 keeps the bit; a hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

fields.name: buserr
fields.description:
Bus error error. Sticky flag that the hardware sets when the AXI4 port answered SLVERR.

Usage: Read after done or after an interrupt; write 1 to this bit to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not set (reset value);
0x1 set.

Unit: none

Limits: A write of 0 keeps the bit; a hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

fields.name: enttmo
fields.description:
Entropy timeout error. Sticky flag that the hardware sets when the entropy input did not deliver words in time.

Usage: Read after done or after an interrupt; write 1 to this bit to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not set (reset value);
0x1 set.

Unit: none

Limits: A write of 0 keeps the bit; a hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

fields.name: keytmo
fields.description:
Key timeout error. Sticky flag that the hardware sets when the key input did not deliver a word in time.

Usage: Read after done or after an interrupt; write 1 to this bit to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not set (reset value);
0x1 set.

Unit: none

Limits: A write of 0 keeps the bit; a hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

fields.name: vasmis
fields.description:
Verify-after-sign mismatch error. Sticky flag that the hardware sets when the check of a new signature failed.

Usage: Read after done or after an interrupt; write 1 to this bit to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not set (reset value);
0x1 set.

Unit: none

Limits: A write of 0 keeps the bit; a hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

fields.name: lockv
fields.description:
Lock violation error. Sticky flag that the hardware sets when a write was refused because the enable lock is set.

Usage: Read after done or after an interrupt; write 1 to this bit to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not set (reset value);
0x1 set.

Unit: none

Limits: A write of 0 keeps the bit; a hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

fields.name: busycmd
fields.description:
Access while busy error. Sticky flag that the hardware sets when a start command or a window write arrived while an operation was running.

Usage: Read after done or after an interrupt; write 1 to this bit to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not set (reset value);
0x1 set.

Unit: none

Limits: A write of 0 keeps the bit; a hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

registers.name: dsig_irq_raw
registers.description: Digital signature raw interrupt register. Holds the sticky interrupt events.

fields.name: done
fields.description:
Operation done raw event. Sticky flag that the hardware sets when an operation that was started by the start command finished, with or without an error.

Usage: Read the status register for the masked value; write 1 to this bit to clear the event after handling it.

Values:
0x0 no event (reset value);
0x1 event pending.

Unit: none

Limits: A write of 0 keeps the bit; a hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

fields.name: err
fields.description:
Error raw event. Sticky flag that the hardware sets when an operation or a command was rejected, or an error flag of the error register was set.

Usage: Read the status register for the masked value; write 1 to this bit to clear the event after handling it.

Values:
0x0 no event (reset value);
0x1 event pending.

Unit: none

Limits: A write of 0 keeps the bit; a hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

fields.name: sec
fields.description:
Security event raw event. Sticky flag that the hardware sets when a fault was detected by verify-after-sign, an enable write was refused while locked, or the random source failed.

Usage: Read the status register for the masked value; write 1 to this bit to clear the event after handling it.

Values:
0x0 no event (reset value);
0x1 event pending.

Unit: none

Limits: A write of 0 keeps the bit; a hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

registers.name: dsig_irq_en
registers.description: Digital signature interrupt enable register. Allows each event to drive the interrupt.

fields.name: done
fields.description:
Operation done interrupt enable. Allows the raw event to drive the interrupt output.

Usage: Write 1 before waiting for the interrupt; clearing it hides the event from the status register and the output.

Values:
0x0 masked (reset value);
0x1 enabled.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: err
fields.description:
Error interrupt enable. Allows the raw event to drive the interrupt output.

Usage: Write 1 before waiting for the interrupt; clearing it hides the event from the status register and the output.

Values:
0x0 masked (reset value);
0x1 enabled.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: sec
fields.description:
Security event interrupt enable. Allows the raw event to drive the interrupt output.

Usage: Write 1 before waiting for the interrupt; clearing it hides the event from the status register and the output.

Values:
0x0 masked (reset value);
0x1 enabled.

Unit: none

Limits: none

registers.name: dsig_irq_inj
registers.description: Digital signature interrupt injection register. Injects events for test.

fields.name: done
fields.description:
Operation done interrupt injection. Test bit that makes the IP raise the raw event as if it had occurred.

Usage: Write 1 to test the interrupt path; the IP raises the raw event on the rising edge of this bit; write 0 and 1 again to inject another event.

Values:
0x0 no injection (reset value);
0x1 inject event.

Unit: none

Limits: Use only in test; it does not start any operation.

fields.name: err
fields.description:
Error interrupt injection. Test bit that makes the IP raise the raw event as if it had occurred.

Usage: Write 1 to test the interrupt path; the IP raises the raw event on the rising edge of this bit; write 0 and 1 again to inject another event.

Values:
0x0 no injection (reset value);
0x1 inject event.

Unit: none

Limits: Use only in test; it does not start any operation.

fields.name: sec
fields.description:
Security event interrupt injection. Test bit that makes the IP raise the raw event as if it had occurred.

Usage: Write 1 to test the interrupt path; the IP raises the raw event on the rising edge of this bit; write 0 and 1 again to inject another event.

Values:
0x0 no injection (reset value);
0x1 inject event.

Unit: none

Limits: Use only in test; it does not start any operation.

registers.name: dsig_irq_sts
registers.description: Digital signature masked interrupt status register. Reports the pending masked events.

fields.name: done
fields.description:
Operation done masked status. Raw event ANDed with its interrupt enable; this is the value that drives the interrupt output.

Usage: Read in the interrupt service routine to find the cause; clear the cause through the raw register.

Values:
0x0 not pending;
0x1 pending.

Unit: none

Limits: Read-only; follows the raw and enable bits.

fields.name: err
fields.description:
Error masked status. Raw event ANDed with its interrupt enable; this is the value that drives the interrupt output.

Usage: Read in the interrupt service routine to find the cause; clear the cause through the raw register.

Values:
0x0 not pending;
0x1 pending.

Unit: none

Limits: Read-only; follows the raw and enable bits.

fields.name: sec
fields.description:
Security event masked status. Raw event ANDed with its interrupt enable; this is the value that drives the interrupt output.

Usage: Read in the interrupt service routine to find the cause; clear the cause through the raw register.

Values:
0x0 not pending;
0x1 pending.

Unit: none

Limits: Read-only; follows the raw and enable bits.

registers.name: dsig_alarm
registers.description: Digital signature alarm register. Holds the sticky security alarm flags.

fields.name: fault
fields.description:
Fault alarm. Sticky flag that the hardware sets when verify-after-sign finds that a new signature does not verify.

Usage: Treat as a possible fault attack; write 1 to this bit to clear it after handling.

Values:
0x0 not set (reset value);
0x1 set.

Unit: none

Limits: Drives the alarm output while set.

fields.name: lockv
fields.description:
Lock violation alarm. Sticky flag that the hardware sets when a write to the enable register is refused while locked.

Usage: Write 1 to this bit to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not set (reset value);
0x1 set.

Unit: none

Limits: Drives the alarm output while set.

fields.name: rngfail
fields.description:
Random source alarm. Sticky flag that the hardware sets when the random source fails its health check or times out.

Usage: Write 1 to this bit to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not set (reset value);
0x1 set.

Unit: none

Limits: Drives the alarm output while set.

registers.name: dsig_win_addr
registers.description: Digital signature window address register. Holds the buffer byte address of the data window.

fields.name: addr
fields.description:
Window address. Byte address in the buffer that the next window write or read uses; the hardware adds 4 after each access.

Usage: Program before accessing the window registers; word aligned.

Values:
0x00000 to 0x0FFFC address (reset value 0x00000).

Unit: byte

Limits: Bits 1:0 are written as 0; an address past the buffer end sets the buffer-overflow error.

registers.name: dsig_win_wr
registers.description: Digital signature window write register. Writes one word into the buffer.

fields.name: data
fields.description:
Window write data. Word that the hardware writes into the buffer at the window address when software writes this register.

Usage: Write after setting the window address; each write advances the address by 4.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF data word.

Unit: word

Limits: Reads as 0.

registers.name: dsig_win_rd
registers.description: Digital signature window read register. Reads one word from the buffer.

fields.name: data
fields.description:
Window read data. Word that the buffer holds at the window address; the hardware advances the address by 4 after each software read.

Usage: Read after setting the window address and after done for results.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF data word.

Unit: word

Limits: The window returns zero while an operation is running and while the buffer is not readable.

registers.name: dsig_cnt_ops
registers.description: Digital signature operation counter register. Counts operations.

fields.name: cnt
fields.description:
Operation count. Number of start commands accepted since reset, when the log feature is built.

Usage: Read to audit use of the IP; frozen after the log lock.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF count (reset value 0x00000000).

Unit: count

Limits: Saturates at 0xFFFFFFFF; reads 0 when the log feature is not built.

registers.name: dsig_cnt_fail
registers.description: Digital signature failure counter register. Counts failed operations.

fields.name: cnt
fields.description:
Failure count. Number of operations that ended with an error flag or an invalid signature, when the log feature is built.

Usage: Read to audit failures; frozen after the log lock.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF count (reset value 0x00000000).

Unit: count

Limits: Saturates at 0xFFFFFFFF; reads 0 when the log feature is not built.

registers.name: dsig_log_lock
registers.description: Digital signature log lock register. Freezes the counters until the next reset.

fields.name: req
fields.description:
Log lock request. Command that freezes the counters until the next reset of the core.

Usage: Write 1 once; hardware latches the lock and clears this bit; it reads as 0.

Values:
0x0 no request (reset value);
0x1 request the lock.

Unit: none

Limits: Has no effect when the log feature is not built.

fields.name: locked
fields.description:
Log lock state. Reports whether the counters are frozen.

Usage: Read after the request to confirm.

Values:
0x0 not locked (reset value);
0x1 locked.

Unit: none

Limits: Cleared only by a reset of the core.

registers.name: dsig_rng
registers.description: Digital signature random source register. Controls and reports the random source.

fields.name: reseed
fields.description:
Reseed command. Command that makes the internal random generator request fresh entropy and reseed.

Usage: Write 1 before a series of signatures or after an alarm; hardware clears the bit when it takes the command.

Values:
0x0 no command (reset value);
0x1 reseed.

Unit: none

Limits: Has no effect when the random source is the entropy input.

fields.name: ready
fields.description:
Random source ready. Reports that the random source can deliver bytes now.

Usage: Poll before a signing start command when a seed may be pending.

Values:
0x0 not ready (reset value);
0x1 ready.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: due
fields.description:
Reseed due. Reports that the internal generator reached its reseed limit.

Usage: Write the reseed command when set.

Values:
0x0 not due (reset value);
0x1 due.

Unit: none

Limits: Reads 0 when the internal generator is not built.

registers.name: dsig_tmo
registers.description: Digital signature timeout register. Sets the entropy and key input timeouts.

fields.name: ent
fields.description:
Entropy timeout. Time that the IP waits for an entropy word before the entropy-timeout error.

Usage: Program before the first operation that needs randomness.

Values:
0x0001 to 0xFFFF timeout (reset value 0xFFFF).

Unit: 1024 core clock cycles

Limits: A value of 0 is treated as 1.

fields.name: key
fields.description:
Key timeout. Time that the IP waits for a key word from the key input before the key-timeout error.

Usage: Program before the first signing operation that uses the key input.

Values:
0x0001 to 0xFFFF timeout (reset value 0xFFFF).

Unit: 1024 core clock cycles

Limits: A value of 0 is treated as 1.

registers.name: dsig_key
registers.description: Digital signature private key register. Receives one 32-bit word of the private key.

fields.name: data
fields.description:
Private key word. One 32-bit word of the private key; word 0 holds the first four key bytes. Software cannot read it back; hardware clears it.

Usage: Write all words of the key before a signing or key-generation start command when the write-only key register is built; hardware clears the words after completion, error, abort or reset.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF key word.

Unit: word

Limits: Reads as 0; 17 words give 68 bytes, enough for a 66-byte P-521 key; unused words are ignored; ML-DSA uses the first 8 words as its 32-byte seed.
